text:
**My pick for most people is the JBL Charge 6.** It's the top choice in What Hi-Fi? and BestProducts, and it's IP68 rated. Battery life figures differ by source (20 hours in one, up to 28 in another). Prices were about $130 at Walmart and $150 at Amazon.
- Reviews and prices: [What Hi-Fi?](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart), [BestProducts](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/)

**Other good options by need:**

- **Floats, with a beach-friendly build: soundcore Boom 3i.** It's IP68, floats upright, resists saltwater, weighs 780 g, and lasts 16 hours. It's $129.99, or about $104 with code AFSC20 (the code doesn't work on items already on sale). [Buy here](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-boom-3i). This is an affiliate link, so the site gets paid if you buy.
- **Budget: Ultimate Ears Wonderboom 4.** It has 360-degree sound and floats. It was about $65 at Amazon, but the battery life is only "good, not great." [BestProducts review](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/)
- **Small and easy to pack: JBL Grip.** Good Housekeeping's best overall. It's IP68, about $100, under a pound, and fits in a backpack bottle pocket. The mesh can look dusty after sandy days. [Good Housekeeping review](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/what-to-buy/a71783745/best-waterproof-speakers/)
- **Bigger sound: Ultimate Ears Epicboom.** Tom's Guide's best overall. It's IP67 but pricey. [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers)
- **Loud party speaker: soundcore Boom 2 Plus.** It's 100 W, IPX7, floats, and lasts up to 20 hours. At 3.8 kg it suits a base camp, not a long walk. It's $249.99, or about $200 with the code. [Buy here](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-boom-2-plus) (affiliate link)

**Tips for pool and beach:**
- IP ratings test for water getting in, not for damage from salt or chlorine. RTINGS recommends rinsing the speaker with fresh water after use, and fabric-covered speakers wear fastest. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth)
- Keep the charging port closed, and let the speaker dry before charging. [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers-for-the-beach-pool-and-shower/)
- If the speaker might end up in the pool, choose one that floats (Boom 3i, Wonderboom 4).

I only had review pages for the JBL and Ultimate Ears models, not direct purchase links. Check current prices on those pages before you buy.
